description: For a finite actual atom family with a common relation symbol and arity, a substitution unifies its specified finite shared term problem exactly when it unifies the atom family, for every residual variable alphabet.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.atom_problem_unifies.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w}
  (A : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.Atom L ℕ))
  (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.HeadCompatible A) (σ : ℕ → L.Term α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.Unifies σ
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.atomProblem A) ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.AtomUnifies σ A
